cave.boulder.description: Rounded boulders: faceted lumpy blobs (one big, smaller companions) with moss-friendly tops.

cave.ceiling.description: Cave ceiling cell, one-sided facing down at the cave storey with lumpy sags (flat near the cell edges so walls and neighbours meet it) and hanging stalactites. Origin at floor level.

cave.cliff.description: Rock cliff face (exterior backdrop or chasm side): one-sided smooth rock sheet facing -Y with stepped strata ledges and a rounded crest; ends fade to a straight profile so cliffs tile along a line.

cave.floor.description: Uneven cave floor cell (4 x 4 m): gentle rounded humps that settle to the shared datum at the cell edges, earth in the hollows and bare rock on the rises; optional still puddle.

cave.ledge.description: Underground ledge: a raised rock shelf with a rounded overhanging lip and lumpy flanks (closed loft of organic rings), walkable flat-ish top; back face flush with a wall line.

cave.mouth.description: Cave mouth: a thick rounded rock arch around a dark opening (closed lofted solid with lumpy rings) and a void card inside, to set into a cliff face or a cave wall line. Origin on the threshold centre, front face toward -Y.

cave.spike.description: Dripstone cluster: lumpy tapering lathe spires. stalagmite rises from the floor, stalactite hangs from the cave storey, column joins floor and ceiling with a waisted middle.

cave.wall.description: Organic cave wall for one cell edge (4 m): a smooth lumpy rock sheet that leans into the ceiling, lumps fading to the shared profile at both ends so cells join seamlessly. corner: an inner 90-degree bend (two edges). Origin on the cell boundary at floor level (corner: the cell centre).

dgn.bridge.description: Narrow stone slab bridge across pit cells (north-south), resting on the rims, with a deep keel and low parapets; spans 1-2 cells. Origin on the deck top at floor level (the keel hangs below the floor).

dgn.ceiling.description: Ceiling over a cell block, one-sided facing down (cameras above see into the room: N64 cutaway). vault: barrel vault along north-south springing at the cornice; flat: slab with timber beams; groin: cross vault per cell with ribs and a boss. Origin at floor level on the cell block centre (geometry at the storey height).

dgn.corridor.description: Corridor cell (4 m): 3 m clear passage between one-sided relief walls, piers on convex corners, flagstone floor, beamed flat ceiling. Kinds: straight, end_wall, end_door (door cut for a dgn.doorway), corner, tee, cross. Open sides carry corridor sockets that must meet another corridor socket.

dgn.door_locked.description: Locked door insert for a dgn.doorway frame (same door anchor). padlock: iron-banded timber leaf with crossed chains and a heavy padlock; open = leaf swung back into the passage, chains gone. bars: iron gate bars; open = bars withdrawn (only the sockets remain). Swap closed/open by flag (presentation piece flag / asset_when_set). Origin = the door anchor of the frame it fills.

dgn.doorway.description: Round-arched stone doorway. frame: fills a 3 x 3.6 m wall cut (2 x 3 m opening), back face on the room.gd door anchor, optional 1.5 m passage sleeve receding into the dark. arch: freestanding arch on two piers spanning a 3 m corridor.

dgn.floor.description: Floor tile for 1-2 x 1-2 cells (covers the full cell block; walls stand on its rim). Kinds: plain flagstones, border (dressed rim), grate (iron drain grate over a dark sump), cracked (sunken broken slabs).

dgn.pillar.description: Free-standing dungeon pillar: square (chamfered shaft, base course, capital), round (tapered drum shaft on a square plinth) or broken (stump with fallen drums).

dgn.pit.description: Pit cell: floor with a hole whose shaft walls fall into the dark (one-sided, void at the bottom), dressed rim stones. full: the whole cell is pit inside a rim; edge: the north half; corner: the north-east quarter.

dgn.room.description: Dungeon room shell on the 4 m grid: one-sided relief walls (mossy plinth, cut-stone body, stepped cornice), pilasters on cell boundaries, flagstone floor with a dressed border, door cuts on cell-edge midpoints for dgn.doorway frames, torch sockets, carved relief panels, open cells for pit pieces. Ceilings are separate dgn.ceiling pieces.

dgn.rubble.description: Rubble heap: rounded faceted stones around a few broken cut blocks (fallen masonry).

dgn.stairs.description: Stair cell against a wall (4 x 4 m). up: a flight rising 2.25 m to a dark arched landing portal in the back wall (the piece replaces the wall segment on its north edge). down: a stairwell sinking into the dark with low parapets on both sides.

dgn.wall.description: Modular wall segment for one (or two) cell edges: origin on the cell boundary, inner face 0.5 m in front. Kinds: solid, door (cut for dgn.doorway), slit (window slit with splayed reveal and a cold glow plate), alcove (arched niche), relief (carved panel), torch (torch socket).

dprop.banner.description: Hanging cloth banner on an iron rod with finials: painted heraldic cloth (original emblem), swallow-tail, point or straight hem. Origin on the wall face at floor level, top at 4.0 m.

dprop.block.description: Pushable block: a chamfered carved stone (every edge bevelled, never a plain cube) with a carved relief motif inset on all four sides and a worn top.

dprop.brazier.description: Standing iron brazier: wide bowl on three splayed legs with a ring brace, heaped glowing coals and a flame.

dprop.breakable.description: Breakable dungeon containers: round clay pot with a rolled lip, tall two-handled urn, or a stack of iron-cornered timber crates.

dprop.chest.description: Iron-banded timber treasure chest with a barrel lid, corner caps and a lock plate; large = the big ornate key chest. open: lid swung back.

dprop.cobweb.description: Corner cobweb: one alpha card spanning the inner corner of two walls under the cornice (painted radial web). Origin on the corner line at floor level; the card faces the room diagonal.

dprop.crystal.description: Crystal cluster: hexagonal pointed prisms of painted glass leaning out of a rock seat; glows faintly.

dprop.plate.description: Floor pressure plate: carved square stone slab with a painted motif in a dressed sunken frame; down = pressed flush.

dprop.sconce.description: Wall torch sconce: iron back plate and bracket holding a tilted timber torch with a painted flame (emissive). Origin on the wall face at floor level; the flame sits at the torch-socket height.

dprop.statue.description: Hooded guardian statue (original design): robed stone figure on a dressed plinth, hands resting on a sword set point-down (or holding a round shield), faceless dark hood.

dprop.switch.description: Switch plinth: carved tapering stone pedestal with a crystal orb in a claw cup (strike to toggle) or an iron floor lever in a slotted block.

dprop.tablet.description: Rune tablet: rounded-top standing stone on a stepped base with a recessed panel of softly glowing original glyphs (emissive, period-correct, no text).

lake.bed.description: Underwater lake floor tile: soft sandy bed with pebble patches at the given depth below the water surface (origin = water surface centre), rounded stones and swaying weed tufts; seen from underwater views (fog tint).

lake.bridge.description: Boat-less crossing over water, north-south: stepping stones (flat rounded rock tops in a meandering line) or a low plank walkway on piles with rope rails. Origin at the crossing centre on the land datum.

lake.dock.description: Timber dock: plank deck on round piles running out over the water from the shore, edge stringers, mooring posts with rope and an optional ladder.

lake.lilies.description: Floating lily pads (thin notched discs) with closed water-lily blooms; origin on the water surface.

lake.reeds.description: Reed clump: thin tapering blades (closed three-sided spines) arching outward from a tuft, with cattail heads; solid geometry so it reads in every pack (no alpha).

lake.shore.description: Shoreline cell (4 x 4 m): land at the datum on the north side sloping under the water to the south (straight), around a convex corner (corner_out: water south and east) or a concave cove (corner_in); grass on top, a pebble beach band through the waterline, sand under water, scattered rounded stones.

lake.water.description: Lake water surface tile: tessellated one-sided plane at the water level (origin = water surface centre) with the pack's painted water role; N64 vertex wobble + slow UV scroll declared as material extras (bounded by the lake gate). Tiles edge to edge; shore pieces overlap its rim.

lake.waterfall.description: Waterfall: a bowed falling-water sheet (pack water role, fast downward scroll stretched into streaks) pouring from a rounded rock lip, white foam puffs and a churned pool rim at the foot. Front faces -Y; origin at the pool centre on the water surface.

nature.bush.description: Bush/shrub of overlapping blobs; optional flower heads (role 'flower') and cap (snow/moss).

nature.tree.description: Tree: broadleaf blobs, stacked conifer tiers, bare branching (cap = snow-laden), birch, palm, crystal (faceted ice trunk, angular branches, glass shards; additive 3.2).

sky.backdrop.description: Sky backdrop: inward-facing dome or cylinder (kit_shell_sky, role 'sky', v = elevation 0..1). Origin at the viewer; extends below y=0 by below_horizon*radius.

tmpl.altar.description: Altar on a two-step dais: dressed block with painted relief panels on the front and sides, overhanging top slab, a bronze offering bowl (optionally burning) and candle stubs.

tmpl.boss_door.description: Boss door: a towering stepped surround (jamb towers, sigil lintel, pediment, braziers' brackets) with sigil-painted arched leaves under a heavy iron lock. Shares the dgn.doorway door anchor and covers the standard frame; open = leaves and lock gone, dark passage beyond.

tmpl.column.description: Temple column: square plinth, moulded base, fluted shaft with entasis, echinus capital and abacus slab; broken = snapped shaft with a jagged top and a fallen drum.

tmpl.dais.description: Stepped temple dais on the grid (1 or 2 cells square): stacked dressed courses with a carved border on the top platform.

tmpl.floor.description: Temple floor tile (1-3 cells square): flagstones framed by a dressed border with a painted relief medallion inlaid at the centre.

tmpl.obelisk.description: Carved obelisk: tapered square shaft with chamfered edges, a pyramidion cap, softly glowing glyph panels on its four faces, on a stepped plinth.

tmpl.relief.description: Carved relief wall panel: painted relief slab (original motif) in a dressed frame with a lintel and a small sill, mounted on a wall face. Origin on the wall face at floor level; panel centred at 2.3 m.

tmpl.wall.description: Temple wall segment for one cell edge: the dungeon relief wall sheet with engaged columns at its ends, a painted frieze band under the cornice and a carved relief panel. Origin on the cell boundary at floor level.

note: Every GLB here exists for consumers only with this sha256 (explicit sRGB8, converted after the kit validators and the DUNGEONKIT gates ran on the linear build; source_sha256 = validated build). textures are relative to kits/library/.
